NONE: › of or like a skeleton (= frame of bones)
骨骼的；骨瘦如柴的

輪廓的，最基本的，大概的

她骨瘦如柴。

他在事故中骨頭嚴重受傷。

報紙只報道了辯論的大致情況。

NONE: › any of the muscles that are attached to the bones and work to create movement of the bones and joints
骨骼肌

骨骼，骨架

框架；架構；梗概，綱要

example: We found an old sheep skeleton up on the cliffs.
我們在懸崖上發現了一副老綿羊的骨架。

長期的疾病使她瘦得只剩皮包骨了。
The skeleton of my book is written/My book is in skeleton form - now I just have to add the details.
我的書已經有了架構——現在我只需要添加細節了。

NONE: › an embarrassing secret
醜事，隱情

NONE: › a key that will open several doors
萬能鎖匙

NONE: C1 the smallest number of people needed for a business or organization to operate

這個倉庫星期天只有必需崗位上的工作人員會上班。

NONE: › a person who doubts the truth or value of an idea or belief
持懷疑態度的人

NONE: C2 doubting that something is true or useful
懷疑的，持懷疑態度的

example: Many experts remain skeptical about/of his claims.

NONE: › to make a sketch of something

NONE: › someone who makes sketches (= drawings)
